title: Senior Principal - Principal, RE – Networks
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Site Reliability Engineer improves the reliability, resilience and observability of GSK's platforms as a hands-on engineer, reducing toil, preventing incidents and meeting agreed reliability targets. The role defines and monitors SLOs, instruments platforms for observability, leads incident response through to permanent prevention, and applies AI and automation for anomaly detection, predictive alerting and self-healing. It also coaches platform engineering teams in reliability practice and error-budget discipline.

The role sits in Reliability Engineering & Operations and is deployed into a platform domain while drawing on the central capability, so it holds the central reliability standard inside a team it does not report to. Platform build and engineering direction sit with the Principal Engineers and the Engineering Director, the major incident process sits with the Major Incident Manager, and the reliability standard itself is set by the Reliability Engineering Senior Director. Reliability targets are held jointly with the Platform Manager rather than imposed on them.

**ROLE SCALE AND COMPLEXITY**

This is a senior enterprise reliability leadership role operating across globally distributed, business-critical Network and Connectivity services. The post holder is accountable for setting technical direction, resolving systemic and ambiguous reliability risks, and influencing prioritisation across multiple platform teams, suppliers and geographies without relying on direct line authority.

The role manages a portfolio of interdependent services with material operational, regulatory, cyber, resilience and financial consequences. It shapes investment and supplier decisions and may influence or govern an annual technology and service portfolio of up to approximately GBP 23 million, where applicable to the assigned scope.

Leads reliability outcomes across global enterprise connectivity, including interdependent campus, data-centre, cloud, manufacturing and market network services. The role addresses failure modes that can affect multiple sites or regions simultaneously and coordinates decisions across network engineering, cyber security, cloud, hosting, business continuity and strategic suppliers.

**MARKET SCOPE**

Global scope, supporting business operations across regions, countries and markets in which GSK operates. The role establishes consistent reliability outcomes across regional delivery teams while accommodating local regulatory, data-residency, business-continuity and market-criticality requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and monitor SLOs for the platforms served, and instrument those platforms for observability so reliability is measured rather than assumed.
* Apply AI and automation for anomaly detection, predictive alerting and self-healing, so that recurring conditions are handled without human intervention.
* Lead incident response for the platforms served, and drive root-cause resolution through to permanent prevention rather than closing on restoration.
* Improve resilience through capacity, failover and recovery engineering, and test recovery rather than documenting it.
* Reduce operational toil through automation and reusable tooling, working the identified manual task and toil candidates and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platforms served, prioritising by the reliability risk each gap leaves unmeasured.
* Coach platform engineering teams in reliability practice and error-budget discipline, so reliability is built in rather than inspected in.
* Track reliability metrics against SLOs and team OKRs, and act on the trend rather than only reporting it.
* Support reliability oversight of supplier-run services, holding partner-operated components to the same SLOs as internal ones.
* Hold the central reliability standard while deployed in a platform domain, escalating to the Reliability Engineering Senior Director where local pressure would erode it.
* Feed reliability evidence into the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, so that resilience work competes on stated risk rather than on goodwill.
* Hold the boundaries with the Principal Engineers on platform build, the Major Incident Manager on the major incident process, and the Platform Manager on the reliability targets the platform commits to.
* Set the multi-year reliability strategy and engineering roadmap for the assigned Network and Connectivity portfolio, translating enterprise risk and business priorities into funded reliability outcomes.
* Own cross-platform reliability governance, including service tiering, SLO policy, error-budget decisions, resilience exceptions and common engineering standards across internal and supplier-operated services.
* Lead resolution of complex, high-impact and systemic failure modes spanning cloud, hosting, network, security, applications and third-party dependencies, with authority to convene senior technical and service leaders.
* Provide evidence-based recommendations for investment, risk acceptance and supplier performance decisions, including prioritisation across a material service portfolio and, where delegated, spend of up to approximately GBP 25 million.
* Represent Reliability Engineering in Director, Senior Director and VP-level governance, communicating service risk, business impact, trade-offs and required decisions in clear executive terms.
* Mentor Principal and Senior Engineers, build communities of practice and raise engineering capability across regions rather than delivering only through individual contribution.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering).
* Reliability or platform certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or ITIL 4 for incident and problem practice).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Site reliability engineering, covering SLOs, observability instrumentation, error budgets and toil reduction.
* AIOps and operations automation, covering anomaly detection, predictive alerting and self-healing.

**Job-Related Experience**

* Overall 15 years and 10+ years in Network engineering or operations, including at least two years in a hands-on site reliability or platform reliability role.
* 5+ years supporting large-scale production network environments.
* Demonstrated experience operating global LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi/Network Services.
* Practical experience managing incidents, problems, changes, and service reliability improvements.
* Proven experience defining and measuring network SLIs, SLOs, and operational KPIs.
* Demonstrated accountability for globally distributed, 24x7, business-critical services and for decisions with material operational, regulatory, customer or financial impact.
* Proven ability to influence Directors, Senior Directors and VP-level stakeholders, including presenting options, quantified risk, trade-offs and investment recommendations.
* Experience governing strategic suppliers and complex service ecosystems, with exposure to substantial technology budgets or portfolios; direct budget ownership is desirable but not mandatory where strong investment influence is evidenced.
* Track record of setting technical direction, leading through ambiguity and developing senior engineering capability across organisational and geographic boundaries.

**Technical Knowledge**

* Strong knowledge of: Routing and Switching, TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, Network Segmentation and NAC, Network Monitoring Platforms
* Experience with: Network automation, APIs, Python scripting, Infrastructure as Code ,CI/CD principles, Telemetry and observability platforms.

**Reliability & Operations**

* Experience improving: Availability, MTTR, Change Success Rate, Service Performance
* Experience performing: RCA investigations, Blameless postmortems, Capacity planning , Resilience testing, Operational governance

**Skills/Background**

* Comfort operating inside a team that is not the reporting line, holding a central standard without formal authority.
* Composure in live incidents, including deciding when to stop investigating and restore.
* Discipline to pursue root cause after service is restored and attention has moved on.
* Ability to coach engineers into reliability practice rather than policing them into it.
* Judgement about which observability gaps matter and which are noise.
* Willingness to automate away the work rather than becoming indispensable to it.

**Skills**

CI/CD, Cloud Based Services, Configuration Management (CM), Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM), Disaster Recovery (DR), Financial Operations, Identity Access Management (IAM), Incident Management, Incident Response, Network Automation, Network Engineering, Operating Systems (OS), Performance Tuning, Scripting, Service Governance, SRE Observability, System Monitors, Telemetry, Vulnerability Management

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Assistant Professor - Data Engineer
description:
**About Newton:**

Newton School of Technology (NST) is a new-age institution redefining technical education in India. Founded by IIT alumni, NST offers a 4-year B.Tech in Computer Science and AI, focused on hands-on learning and deep industry integration. Within two years, over 93% of students have secured paid internships with companies like Razorpay, SarvamAI, and DRDO, along with global exposure through tech treks to Singapore and Silicon Valley. Led by a distinguished faculty comprising ICPC World Finalists and ex-professionals from ISRO, Microsoft, MakeMyTrip, and several other leading tech organizations, NST is building a scalable, high-impact model that produces industry-ready talent for the world’s most advanced technology roles.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced
**Assistant Professor**
-
**Data Engineer**
to join our team. This role is a perfect blend of technical leadership and mentoring. You’ll be contributing to cutting-edge web development projects while guiding and inspiring the next generation of software engineers.

If you’re passionate about coding, solving complex problems, and helping others grow, this role is for you!

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Curriculum Development:

● Design and develop Data Visual Analytics, DBMS course content, lesson plans,

and practical assignments.

● Stay updated with the latest trends in database technologies and incorporate them

into the curriculum.

**2. Teaching and Training:**

● Deliver lectures and hands-on sessions on database concepts such as relational

models, SQL, NoSQL, normalization, and database design.

● Provide real-world use cases and examples to enhance student understanding.

● Teach advanced topics like query optimization, database security, data warehousing,

and cloud databases.

● Build real-world capstone projects that combine data visualization with AI/ML

applications.

● Stay up to date with the latest industry trends and tools in Data Science, AI/ML, and

Visual Analytics.

**3. Assessment and Feedback:**

● Develop and administer tests, quizzes, and projects to assess student progress.

● Provide constructive feedback and mentorship to help students excel.

**4. Student Engagement:**

● Foster an engaging and collaborative classroom environment.

● Assist students in troubleshooting database issues or practical exercises.

● Guide students on career opportunities in database management and related fields.

**5. Industry Relevance:**

● Share insights on industry practices and tools like MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB,

Oracle,Power BI, Excel, Tableau etc.

● Organize workshops, hackathons, or webinars for hands-on learning experiences.

**6. Collaboration:**

● Work with other instructors and departments to integrate database concepts into

multidisciplinary projects.

● Adapt teaching methodologies to suit diverse learning styles.

**Qualifications and Requirements:**

1. Education/Experience:

●
**M.tech/Phd**
degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or

related fields.

● Expertise in Data Engineering.

● Certifications in database technologies (e.g., Oracle DBA, Microsoft SQL Server,

AWS Certified Database Specialist) are a plus.

2. Technical Skills:

● Proficiency in relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle) and NoSQL

systems (MongoDB, Cassandra, Knn and Clustering).

● Tableau or Power BI.

● Strong command of Python, SQL, PL/SQL, or T-SQL.

● Familiarity with database design, normalization, indexing, and performance tuning.

● Knowledge of cloud database platforms like AWS RDS, Azure SQL, or Google

Cloud Spanner.

**Experience: 3+ years**

title: Lead UX Research
description:
**Job Title**

Lead UX Research

**Role Overview**
-----------------

  

The Principal UX Researcher, AI Experiences will guide research and experience strategy for reusable AI capabilities across Amadeus Business Lines.

Working collaboratively with Product, Design, Engineering, and Architecture teams, you’ll help shape how users understand, trust, and interact with AI-powered systems. Areas of focus include explainability, confidence, AI monitoring, Human-in-the-Loop controls, agent activity, and responsible AI.

This is a senior individual contributor position that blends practical design judgment, applied UX research expertise, and an understanding of AI technology.

  

**In this role, you’ll:**
-------------------------

AI Experience Research

* Drive research for complex AI-powered products and platforms.
* Explore user expectations around AI transparency, trust, control, and monitoring.
* Develop research strategies using interviews, contextual inquiry, usability testing, and concept validation.
* Translate insights into actionable design principles and product recommendations.
* Evaluate AI experiences across conversational, operational, API-enabled, and multi-channel workflows.

Experience Strategy & Design

* Shape the experience vision for capabilities like explainability, monitoring, Human-in-the-Loop, and agent orchestration.
* Define how AI decisions, confidence levels, progress, and exceptions are presented to different users.
* Collaborate with UX Designers to develop journeys, prototypes, and validated interaction patterns.
* Balance usability with technical, security, and privacy considerations.
* Help establish reusable AI experience patterns for adoption across teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Partner with Product Managers, AI Engineers, and Business Lines to identify shared experience needs.
* Facilitate workshops to align research, design, and priorities.
* Bring user evidence into product planning and capability discussions.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to clarify direction in evolving AI problem spaces.
Contribute to mentoring and continuous learning across UX and AI communities.  

  

**Your Profile**
----------------

* Typically brings over a decade of experience in UX research, experience design, or human-centered product development.
* Significant experience in enterprise or platform environments.
* Practical exposure to AI-powered experiences (Generative AI, Agentic AI, etc.).
* Experience leading or shaping research strategy across products.
* Understanding of trust, explainability, automation, and responsible AI principles.
* Ability to translate insights into user experience direction.
* Working knowledge of tools like Figma, Miro, or similar.
* Strong facilitation, storytelling, and communication abilities.
Comfortable working in dynamic, ambiguous or emerging domains.  

  

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Hands-on UX or interaction design experience.
* Experience designing dashboards, monitoring tools, or decision-support systems.
* Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and confidence indicators.
* Awareness of accessibility, data visualization, and multi-channel experience design.
* Experience with AI governance, privacy, or regulatory frameworks.
Understanding of domains such as travel, payments, or enterprise solutions.  

  

**Success in this Role**
------------------------

You’ll help build a research-driven experience framework for reusable AI capabilities—enabling Amadeus Business Lines to deliver AI products that are clear, trustworthy, and easy to operate. Your work ensures that core AI experiences reflect real user needs and support adoption at scale.

  

Organization: AI Delivery Hub
  
Experience: Typically 14+ years or equivalent experience in human-centered product development
  
Role Type: Senior individual contributor and cross-team UX leader
  
Primary Focus: UX research, experience strategy, and reusable AI interaction patterns

  

**What we can offer you**
-------------------------

A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.
  
Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.
  
A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.
  
A hybrid working model - We want our employees to do their best work, however the hybrid model works best for them.
  
A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.
  
A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.
  
A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.

  
  

#LI-KA1

**Diversity & Inclusion**

  

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience.

  

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

**Be aware of recruitment scams**

  

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.
